0022600186.text: The Heat (2-4) come into this game on a two-game winning streak, 1-3 at home and 1-1 on the road, and sit 10th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Southeast. The Clippers (1-5) are on a five-game losing streak and sit 13th in the West, and six of their players are out: Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Derrick Jones Jr. (knee soreness), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps bruise), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The Heat won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 140-123 win in Miami on December 1, 2025, and the two teams have not yet met this season.
